correct.description: Lying on the back, legs raised together with control to roughly vertical, lower back stays flat against the mat

common_errors.description: Lower back arches off the mat instead of staying flat

keypoint_signature.rule: angle(shoulder, hip, knee) deviates from threshold.legraise_neutral_hip_angle by more than threshold.legraise_lumbar_arch_tolerance

common_errors.description: Legs swing up using momentum instead of a controlled lift

thresholds._status: SEED values only -- placeholders pending real field-measured tuning per EXERCISE_LIBRARY.md §4. Not authoritative; do not treat as validated.

rep_counting._note: "top" = legs down/hip extended (rest reference, highest hip angle), "bottom" = legs raised/hip flexed (peak, lowest hip angle) -- same top=rest/bottom=effort convention as squat.json. rep_complete_transition is descending_to_top (not ascending_to_top) because the rep's counted excursion is legs-up-then-down, the mirror of squat's stand-then-descend.

coaching_cues.setup: Lie flat, hands at your sides or under hips
coaching_cues.execution: Raise your legs together, keep your back flat
coaching_cues.set_complete_with_flags: Good set. Next time, watch your {flag_body_part} — {flag_cue}.

flag_cues.lumbar_arch: Press your lower back into the mat

back_injury.modification: Bend your knees to reduce lever length, or place hands under your hips for support. Stop if you feel lumbar pressure.

hip_injury.modification: Reduce range of motion. Stop if you feel hip pain.

hypertension.modification: Avoid breath-holding. Breathe out as you raise your legs.

model_assist.notes: Advisory only. May detect rule-less errors (e.g. asymmetric leg lift, knee bend compensating for tight hamstrings). Cannot override rep count or safety flags. Default off until eval passes.

camera_guidance.framing_note: Phone on the floor, side profile, hips and both legs in frame through the full range.
